title: Happy snail
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- snail body -->
  <path d='M12 72 Q10 60 25 58 L75 58 Q92 58 90 72 Q88 84 72 84 L28 84 Q12 84 12 72Z' fill='#5BC8AF'/>
  <!-- body underside highlight -->
  <path d='M18 78 Q40 86 82 78 Q86 82 82 84 Q50 90 20 84 Q16 82 18 78Z' fill='#8AF0D8'/>
  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <rect x='30' y='38' width='4' height='20' rx='2' fill='#5BC8AF'/>
  <rect x='42' y='34' width='4' height='24' rx='2' fill='#5BC8AF'/>
  <!-- eye balls -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='36' r='6' fill='#FFF5D6'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='6' fill='#FFF5D6'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#3A2E5C'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#3A2E5C'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='34' r='1' fill='#FFF5D6'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='30' r='1' fill='#FFF5D6'/>
  <!-- shell -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='24' fill='#FF8C5A'/>
  <!-- shell spiral -->
  <path d='M58 34 Q76 36 76 52 Q76 66 62 66 Q50 66 50 54 Q50 46 58 46 Q64 46 64 52 Q64 56 60 56' 
        fill='none' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FFB48A'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M24 70 Q30 76 38 70' fill='none' stroke='#3A2E5C' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='68' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF9BC0'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='66' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF9BC0'/>
</svg>
